nodes.title: Caption
widgets_values:
Global Metadata: genre is 80s hip hop, subgenre is boom bap, BPM is 92, key is C minor with a pentatonic scale, feeling shifts from playful and bouncy to melancholic and reflective, it fits for late night drives or urban study sessions, recording should sound warm and slightly lo-fi with tape saturation.
Vocal Details: voice is male, sounds gritty and conversational like an old-school MC, performed with a laid-back flow and slight ad-libs, there are no harmonies but a soft backing vocal layer adds texture in the chorus.
Arrangement: instruments that carry the song include a crisp snare and a melodic bassline, supported by a muted electric guitar and a dusty drum machine, the beat switches from a steady four-on-the-floor feel to a syncopated break in the bridge, groove is relaxed and syncopated, bass plays a walking line while drums maintain a tight pocket, recording has plenty of headroom with subtle reverb on the vocals.
